component: Exchange language interop factory registration and caller

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The factory rename changes its component contract from ews-interop to exchange-interop and updates the Rust create_instance call to match. The interface UUID and component CID remain. The original one-identifier factory still delegates to ForHostname. The accepted factory and its moved Rust consumer instead pass type, hostname and username to ForAccount; that expansion is a later phase. Matching source registration/caller names do not prove compiled ABI or live authentication equivalence.
title: The Exchange interop rename updates its contract and Rust caller together
